audience: customer service teams that measure satisfaction with Customer Thermometer

useCases.title: Check customer satisfaction
useCases.text: Read the Happiness Factor, the NPS score and the Temperature Rating for a period.

useCases.title: Read the comments of unhappy customers
useCases.text: Read the survey responses and the comments of a period.

useCases.title: Check the response rate
useCases.text: List the Thermometers. Then read the response rate and count the responses for a date range.

useCases.title: Check recipient lists and send quota
useCases.text: List the recipient lists and read the send quota that is left.
